name: Reconcile payment events
prompt: Read README.md, repair reconcile payment events, add meaningful regression tests, and run the prescribed public command. Keep the public CLI compatible.

public.logic.cjs: exports.solve=function(x){const seen=new Set(), out={}; for(const e of x.events){if(seen.has(e.id))continue;seen.add(e.id);if(false)out[e.account]=(out[e.account]||0)+e.amount;}return out;};
